bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for lead service line replacement grants.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; LEAD SERVICE LINE REPLACEMENT GRANTS. +]

[+$240,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the Public Facilities Authority to provide grants under Minnesota Statutes, section 446A.077. This appropriation is onetime and is available until June 30, 2033. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for lead service line replacement grants.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; LEAD SERVICE LINE REPLACEMENT GRANTS.

$240,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the Public Facilities Authority to provide grants under Minnesota Statutes, section 446A.077. This appropriation is onetime and is available until June 30, 2033.
additions: APPROPRIATION; LEAD SERVICE LINE REPLACEMENT GRANTS.
